per_query.question: Welche Kundenkonten haben ihren Monatsumsatz vom ersten zum letzten aktiven Monat am staerksten gesteigert (mindestens 5 Bestellungen insgesamt)?
per_query.candidate_sql:
WITH MonthlyRevenue AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id, 
        DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date) AS month, 
        SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS revenue
    FROM 
        public.orders o
    JOIN 
        public.order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
    GROUP BY 
        o.customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)
),
CustomerGrowth AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT month) AS active_months,
        MIN(month) AS first_month,
        MAX(month) AS last_month
    FROM 
        MonthlyRevenue
    GROUP BY 
        customer_id
    HAVING 
        COUNT(DISTINCT month) > 1
),
CustomerOrderCount AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_orders
    FROM 
        public.orders
    GROUP BY 
        customer_id
    HAVING 
        COUNT(*) >= 5
)
SELECT 
    cg.customer_id, 
    cu.company_name,
    (SELECT revenue FROM MonthlyRevenue WHERE customer_id = cg.customer_id AND month = cg.first_month) AS first_month_revenue,
    (SELECT revenue FROM MonthlyRevenue WHERE customer_id = cg.customer_id AND month = cg.last_month) AS last_month_revenue,
    ((SELECT revenue FROM MonthlyRevenue WHERE customer_id = cg.customer_id AND month = cg.last_month) -
     (SELECT revenue FROM MonthlyRevenue WHERE customer_id = cg.customer_id AND month = cg.first_month)) AS revenue_growth
FROM 
    CustomerGrowth cg
JOIN 
    CustomerOrderCount co ON cg.customer_id = co.customer_id
JOIN 
    public.customers cu ON cg.customer_id = cu.customer_id
ORDER BY 
    revenue_growth DESC
LIMIT 10;
per_query.reference_sql:
WITH order_totals AS (
    SELECT o.order_id,
           o.customer_id,
           DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date AS month,
           SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS order_revenue
    FROM public.orders o
    JOIN public.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY o.order_id, o.customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date
),
monthly AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           month,
           SUM(order_revenue) AS month_revenue,
           COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS month_orders
    FROM order_totals
    GROUP BY customer_id, month
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT m.*,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.customer_id ORDER BY m.month) AS rn_first,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.customer_id ORDER BY m.month DESC) AS rn_last
    FROM monthly m
),
first_last AS (
    SELECT r.customer_id,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rn_first = 1 THEN month END) AS first_month,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rn_last = 1 THEN month END) AS last_month,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rn_first = 1 THEN month_revenue END) AS first_month_revenue,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rn_last = 1 THEN month_revenue END) AS last_month_revenue
    FROM ranked r
    GROUP BY r.customer_id
),
customer_orders AS (
    SELECT o.customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders
    FROM public.orders o
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT c.customer_id,
       c.company_name,
       fl.first_month,
       fl.last_month,
       fl.first_month_revenue,
       fl.last_month_revenue,
       (fl.last_month_revenue - fl.first_month_revenue) AS revenue_growth
FROM first_last fl
JOIN customer_orders co ON co.customer_id = fl.customer_id
JOIN public.customers c ON c.customer_id = fl.customer_id
WHERE co.total_orders >= 5
  AND fl.last_month > fl.first_month
ORDER BY revenue_growth DESC, c.customer_id

per_query.question: Welche Kundensegmente haben hohen Umsatz, aber geringe Wiederkaufrate (Bestellungen pro Kunde)?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT cd.customer_desc AS Kundensegment, 
       SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity) AS Umsatz, 
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS Bestellungen_pro_Kunde
FROM public.customer_customer_demo ccd
JOIN public.customer_demographics cd ON ccd.customer_type_id = cd.customer_type_id
JOIN public.customers c ON ccd.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN public.orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN public.order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
GROUP BY cd.customer_desc
HAVING SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity) > 10000 -- High revenue threshold
   AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) < 2 -- Low repeat purchase rate
ORDER BY Umsatz DESC;
per_query.reference_sql:
SELECT cd.customer_type_id,
       cd.customer_desc,
       SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customer_count,
       (COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id), 0)) AS orders_per_customer
FROM public.customer_demographics cd
JOIN public.customer_customer_demo ccd ON ccd.customer_type_id = cd.customer_type_id
JOIN public.customers c ON c.customer_id = ccd.customer_id
JOIN public.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN public.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY cd.customer_type_id, cd.customer_desc
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, orders_per_customer ASC, cd.customer_type_id

per_query.question: Welche Laender kombinieren hohen Umsatz mit langer durchschnittlicher Lieferdauer?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT o.ship_country, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity) AS total_revenue, AVG(o.shipped_date - o.order_date) AS avg_delivery_time
FROM public.orders o
JOIN public.order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
WHERE o.shipped_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY o.ship_country
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, avg_delivery_time DESC
LIMIT 5;
per_query.reference_sql:
SELECT c.country,
       SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue,
       AVG((o.shipped_date - o.order_date)::numeric) FILTER (WHERE o.shipped_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_date IS NOT NULL) AS avg_shipping_days,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM public.customers c
JOIN public.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN public.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, avg_shipping_days DESC NULLS LAST, c.country

per_query.question: Welche Kategorien haben nach Rabatt die hoechste Umsatzvolatilitaet zwischen Monaten?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, 
       EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS year, 
       EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) AS month, 
       SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS monthly_revenue,
       STDDEV(SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount))) OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_id) AS revenue_volatility
FROM public.orders o
JOIN public.order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
JOIN public.products p ON od.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN public.categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name, year, month
ORDER BY revenue_volatility DESC
LIMIT 5;
per_query.reference_sql:
WITH category_monthly AS (
    SELECT c.category_id,
           c.category_name,
           DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date AS month,
           SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS month_revenue
    FROM public.categories c
    JOIN public.products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id
    JOIN public.order_details od ON od.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN public.orders o ON o.order_id = od.order_id
    GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name, DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date
),
volatility AS (
    SELECT category_id,
           category_name,
           STDDEV_SAMP(month_revenue) AS revenue_stddev,
           AVG(month_revenue) AS revenue_avg,
           COUNT(*) AS month_points
    FROM category_monthly
    GROUP BY category_id, category_name
)
SELECT category_id,
       category_name,
       revenue_stddev,
       revenue_avg,
       month_points
FROM volatility
ORDER BY revenue_stddev DESC NULLS LAST, category_id

per_query.question: Welche Mitarbeitenden dominieren einzelne Regionen stark (Anteil groesser als 50 Prozent des Regionalumsatzes)?
per_query.candidate_sql:
WITH regional_revenue AS (
    SELECT r.region_id, r.region_description, 
           SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_region_revenue
    FROM public.orders o
    JOIN public.order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
    JOIN public.territories t ON o.ship_region = t.territory_id
    JOIN public.region r ON t.region_id = r.region_id
    GROUP BY r.region_id, r.region_description
),
employee_revenue AS (
    SELECT e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, r.region_id, 
           SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_employee_revenue
    FROM public.orders o
    JOIN public.order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
    JOIN public.employees e ON o.employee_id = e.employee_id
    JOIN public.territories t ON o.ship_region = t.territory_id
    JOIN public.region r ON t.region_id = r.region_id
    GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, r.region_id
)
SELECT er.employee_id, er.first_name, er.last_name, rr.region_description, 
       er.total_employee_revenue, rr.total_region_revenue
FROM employee_revenue er
JOIN regional_revenue rr ON er.region_id = rr.region_id
WHERE er.total_employee_revenue > 0.5 * rr.total_region_revenue
ORDER BY rr.total_region_revenue DESC, er.total_employee_revenue DESC;
per_query.reference_sql:
WITH employee_regions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT et.employee_id, t.region_id
    FROM public.employee_territories et
    JOIN public.territories t ON t.territory_id = et.territory_id
),
employee_region_revenue AS (
    SELECT r.region_id,
           r.region_description,
           e.employee_id,
           e.first_name,
           e.last_name,
           SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS revenue
    FROM employee_regions er
    JOIN public.region r ON r.region_id = er.region_id
    JOIN public.employees e ON e.employee_id = er.employee_id
    JOIN public.orders o ON o.employee_id = e.employee_id
    JOIN public.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY r.region_id, r.region_description, e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name
),
with_share AS (
    SELECT err.*,
           SUM(err.revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY err.region_id) AS region_total_revenue,
           (err.revenue / NULLIF(SUM(err.revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY err.region_id), 0)) AS region_revenue_share
    FROM employee_region_revenue err
)
SELECT region_id,
       region_description,
       employee_id,
       first_name,
       last_name,
       revenue,
       region_total_revenue,
       region_revenue_share
FROM with_share
WHERE region_revenue_share > 0.50
ORDER BY region_revenue_share DESC, region_id, employee_id

per_query.question: Welche Kunden bestellen haeufig verschiedene Produktfamilien, aber mit unterdurchschnittlichem Warenkorbwert?
per_query.candidate_sql:
WITH AverageBasketValue AS (
    SELECT customer_id, AVG(total_value) AS avg_basket_value
    FROM (
        SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_value
        FROM public.orders o
        JOIN public.order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
        GROUP BY o.order_id, o.customer_id
    ) AS order_totals
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
ProductFamilyCount AS (
    SELECT o.customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.category_id) AS product_family_count
    FROM public.orders o
    JOIN public.order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
    JOIN public.products p ON od.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
OverallAverage AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_basket_value) AS overall_avg
    FROM AverageBasketValue
)
SELECT c.customer_id, c.company_name, af.avg_basket_value, pf.product_family_count
FROM public.customers c
JOIN AverageBasketValue af ON c.customer_id = af.customer_id
JOIN ProductFamilyCount pf ON c.customer_id = pf.customer_id
JOIN OverallAverage oa ON af.avg_basket_value < oa.overall_avg
WHERE pf.product_family_count > 1
ORDER BY pf.product_family_count DESC, af.avg_basket_value ASC;
per_query.reference_sql:
WITH order_totals AS (
    SELECT o.order_id,
           o.customer_id,
           SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS order_value
    FROM public.orders o
    JOIN public.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY o.order_id, o.customer_id
),
customer_category_diversity AS (
    SELECT o.customer_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT p.category_id) AS distinct_categories
    FROM public.orders o
    JOIN public.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN public.products p ON p.product_id = od.product_id
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
customer_stats AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id,
           c.company_name,
           COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
           AVG(ot.order_value) AS avg_order_value,
           ccd.distinct_categories
    FROM public.customers c
    JOIN public.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN order_totals ot ON ot.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN customer_category_diversity ccd ON ccd.customer_id = c.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.company_name, ccd.distinct_categories
),
baseline AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_order_value) AS global_avg_order_value
    FROM customer_stats
)
SELECT cs.customer_id,
       cs.company_name,
       cs.order_count,
       cs.distinct_categories,
       cs.avg_order_value
FROM customer_stats cs
CROSS JOIN baseline b
WHERE cs.order_count >= 8
  AND cs.distinct_categories >= 4
  AND cs.avg_order_value < b.global_avg_order_value
ORDER BY cs.distinct_categories DESC, cs.order_count DESC, cs.avg_order_value ASC, cs.customer_id

per_query.question: Bei welchen Versanddienstleistern haeufen sich verspaetete Lieferungen besonders bei hochrabattierten Auftraegen?
per_query.reference_sql:
WITH order_discount AS (
    SELECT o.order_id,
           o.ship_via,
           o.required_date,
           o.shipped_date,
           AVG(od.discount) AS avg_discount
    FROM public.orders o
    JOIN public.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY o.order_id, o.ship_via, o.required_date, o.shipped_date
),
shipper_stats AS (
    SELECT s.shipper_id,
           s.company_name,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE od.avg_discount >= 0.15) AS high_discount_orders,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE od.avg_discount >= 0.15 AND od.shipped_date IS NOT NULL AND od.required_date IS NOT NULL AND od.shipped_date > od.required_date) AS high_discount_late_orders
    FROM order_discount od
    JOIN public.shippers s ON s.shipper_id = od.ship_via
    GROUP BY s.shipper_id, s.company_name
)
SELECT shipper_id,
       company_name,
       high_discount_orders,
       high_discount_late_orders,
       (high_discount_late_orders::numeric / NULLIF(high_discount_orders, 0)) AS high_discount_late_ratio
FROM shipper_stats
ORDER BY high_discount_late_ratio DESC NULLS LAST, high_discount_late_orders DESC, shipper_id

per_query.question: Welche Regionen erzielen hohen Umsatz, obwohl ihre Auftragszahl unter dem Median liegt?
per_query.candidate_sql:
WITH RegionOrderCount AS (
    SELECT o.ship_region AS region, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
    FROM public.orders o
    GROUP BY o.ship_region
),
RegionRevenue AS (
    SELECT o.ship_region AS region, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity) AS total_revenue
    FROM public.orders o
    JOIN public.order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
    GROUP BY o.ship_region
),
MedianOrderCount AS (
    SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_count) AS median_order_count
    FROM RegionOrderCount
)
SELECT rc.region, rc.order_count, rr.total_revenue
FROM RegionOrderCount rc
JOIN RegionRevenue rr ON rc.region = rr.region
JOIN MedianOrderCount mc ON rc.order_count < mc.median_order_count
ORDER BY rr.total_revenue DESC;
per_query.reference_sql:
WITH employee_regions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT et.employee_id, t.region_id
    FROM public.employee_territories et
    JOIN public.territories t ON t.territory_id = et.territory_id
),
region_stats AS (
    SELECT r.region_id,
           r.region_description,
           COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
           SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue
    FROM employee_regions er
    JOIN public.region r ON r.region_id = er.region_id
    JOIN public.orders o ON o.employee_id = er.employee_id
    JOIN public.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY r.region_id, r.region_description
),
median_orders AS (
    SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_count) AS med_order_count
    FROM region_stats
)
SELECT rs.region_id,
       rs.region_description,
       rs.order_count,
       rs.total_revenue
FROM region_stats rs
CROSS JOIN median_orders mo
WHERE rs.order_count < mo.med_order_count
ORDER BY rs.total_revenue DESC, rs.region_id

per_query.question: Bei welchen Versanddienstleistern ist der Anteil stark verspaeteter Sendungen (mehr als 3 Tage) am groessten?
per_query.reference_sql:
SELECT s.shipper_id,
       s.company_name,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.shipped_date IS NOT NULL AND o.required_date IS NOT NULL AND (o.shipped_date - o.required_date) > 3) AS strongly_late_orders,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.shipped_date IS NOT NULL AND o.required_date IS NOT NULL) AS dated_shipped_orders,
       (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.shipped_date IS NOT NULL AND o.required_date IS NOT NULL AND (o.shipped_date - o.required_date) > 3)::numeric
         / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.shipped_date IS NOT NULL AND o.required_date IS NOT NULL), 0)) AS strongly_late_ratio
FROM public.orders o
JOIN public.shippers s ON s.shipper_id = o.ship_via
GROUP BY s.shipper_id, s.company_name
ORDER BY strongly_late_ratio DESC NULLS LAST, strongly_late_orders DESC, s.shipper_id

per_query.question: In welchen Produktkategorien kommt mindestens 60 Prozent des rabattierten Umsatzes von nur einem Lieferanten?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT p.category_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.supplier_id) AS supplier_count, 
       SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS discounted_revenue,
       MAX(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS max_supplier_revenue
FROM public.order_details od
JOIN public.products p ON od.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.category_id
HAVING MAX(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) >= 0.6 * SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount))
per_query.reference_sql:
WITH supplier_category_revenue AS (
    SELECT c.category_id,
           c.category_name,
           s.supplier_id,
           s.company_name AS supplier_name,
           SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS revenue
    FROM public.categories c
    JOIN public.products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id
    JOIN public.suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id
    JOIN public.order_details od ON od.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name, s.supplier_id, s.company_name
),
with_share AS (
    SELECT scr.*,
           SUM(scr.revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY scr.category_id) AS category_total_revenue,
           (scr.revenue / NULLIF(SUM(scr.revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY scr.category_id), 0)) AS supplier_share
    FROM supplier_category_revenue scr
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT ws.*,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ws.category_id ORDER BY ws.supplier_share DESC, ws.supplier_id) AS rn
    FROM with_share ws
)
SELECT category_id,
       category_name,
       supplier_id,
       supplier_name,
       revenue,
       category_total_revenue,
       supplier_share
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
  AND supplier_share >= 0.60
ORDER BY supplier_share DESC, category_id

per_query.question: Welche Kunden haben ueberdurchschnittliche Rabattquote, aber unterdurchschnittlichen Nettoumsatz pro Bestellung?
per_query.candidate_sql:
WITH OrderSummary AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        od.order_id,
        SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS net_revenue,
        AVG(od.discount) AS avg_discount
    FROM public.orders o
    JOIN public.order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
    GROUP BY o.customer_id, od.order_id
),
CustomerStats AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        AVG(net_revenue) AS avg_net_revenue,
        AVG(avg_discount) AS avg_discount
    FROM OrderSummary
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
OverallStats AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(avg_net_revenue) AS overall_avg_net_revenue,
        AVG(avg_discount) AS overall_avg_discount
    FROM CustomerStats
)
SELECT 
    c.customer_id,
    c.company_name,
    cs.avg_net_revenue,
    cs.avg_discount
FROM public.customers c
JOIN CustomerStats cs ON c.customer_id = cs.customer_id
JOIN OverallStats os ON 1=1
WHERE cs.avg_net_revenue < os.overall_avg_net_revenue
  AND cs.avg_discount > os.overall_avg_discount;
per_query.reference_sql:
WITH customer_stats AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id,
           c.company_name,
           AVG(od.discount) AS avg_discount,
           SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS net_revenue,
           COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
           (SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0)) AS revenue_per_order
    FROM public.customers c
    JOIN public.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN public.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.company_name
),
global_baseline AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_discount) AS global_avg_discount,
           AVG(revenue_per_order) AS global_avg_revenue_per_order
    FROM customer_stats
)
SELECT cs.customer_id,
       cs.company_name,
       cs.avg_discount,
       cs.revenue_per_order,
       cs.net_revenue,
       cs.order_count
FROM customer_stats cs
CROSS JOIN global_baseline gb
WHERE cs.avg_discount > gb.global_avg_discount
  AND cs.revenue_per_order < gb.global_avg_revenue_per_order
ORDER BY cs.avg_discount DESC, cs.revenue_per_order ASC, cs.customer_id

per_query.question: Welche Mitarbeitenden haben viele grenzueberschreitende Auftraege, aber unterdurchschnittlichen Umsatz je Auftrag?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT e.employee_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS grenzueberschreitende_auftraege, AVG(od.unit_price * od.quantity) AS durchschnittlicher_umsatz_je_auftrag
FROM public.orders o
JOIN public.order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
JOIN public.employees e ON o.employee_id = e.employee_id
WHERE o.ship_country != 'USA'
GROUP BY e.employee_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 5 AND AVG(od.unit_price * od.quantity) < (
    SELECT AVG(od2.unit_price * od2.quantity)
    FROM public.order_details od2

    FROM public.employees e

    WHERE o.ship_country IS NOT NULL

    GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name
),
baseline AS (

    FROM employee_cross_border
)

       ecb.last_name,
       ecb.cross_orders,
       ecb.cross_revenue,
       ecb.revenue_per_cross_order
FROM employee_cross_border ecb

  AND ecb.revenue_per_cross_order < b.avg_revenue_per_cross_order
ORDER BY ecb.cross_orders DESC, ecb.revenue_per_cross_order ASC, ecb.employee_id

per_query.question: Welche Produktpaare aus unterschiedlichen Kategorien werden ueberproportional oft gemeinsam gekauft (Lift gegenueber Unabhaengigkeit)?

WITH ProductPairs AS (
  SELECT 
    od1.product_id AS product_id1, 
    od2.product_id AS product_id2, 
    COUNT(*) AS pair_count
  FROM 
    public.order_details od1
  JOIN 
    public.order_details od2 ON od1.order_id = od2.order_id AND od1.product_id < od2.product_id
  JOIN 
    public.products p1 ON od1.product_id = p1.product_id
  JOIN 
    public.products p2 ON od2.product_id = p2.product_id
  WHERE 
    p1.category_id <> p2.category_id
  GROUP BY 
    od1.product_id, od2.product_id
),
ProductCounts AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id, 
    COUNT(*) AS total_count
  FROM 
    public.order_details
  GROUP BY 
    product_id
),
LiftCalculation AS (
  SELECT 
    pp.product_id1, 
    pp.product_id2, 
    pp.pair_count, 
    pc1.total_count AS total_count1, 
    pc2.total_count AS total_count2,
    (pp.pair_count::float / (pc1.total_count * pc2.total_count)) AS lift
  FROM 
    ProductPairs pp
  JOIN 
    ProductCounts pc1 ON pp.product_id1 = pc1.product_id
  JOIN 
    ProductCounts pc2 ON pp.product_id2 = pc2.product_id
)
SELECT 
  p1.product_name AS product_name1, 
  p2.product_name AS product_name2, 
  lc.lift
FROM 
  LiftCalculation lc
JOIN 
  public.products p1 ON lc.product_id1 = p1.product_id
JOIN 
  public.products p2 ON lc.product_id2 = p2.product_id
ORDER BY 
  lc.lift DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH total_orders AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)::numeric AS n_orders
    FROM public.orders
),
product_order_counts AS (
    SELECT od.product_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT od.order_id)::numeric AS product_orders
    FROM public.order_details od
    GROUP BY od.product_id
),
pair_counts AS (
    SELECT od1.product_id AS product_id_1,
           od2.product_id AS product_id_2,
           COUNT(DISTINCT od1.order_id)::numeric AS pair_orders
    FROM public.order_details od1
    JOIN public.order_details od2
      ON od1.order_id = od2.order_id
     AND od1.product_id < od2.product_id
    GROUP BY od1.product_id, od2.product_id
),
pair_with_meta AS (
    SELECT pc.product_id_1,
           p1.product_name AS product_name_1,
           c1.category_name AS category_1,
           poc1.product_orders AS product_orders_1,
           pc.product_id_2,
           p2.product_name AS product_name_2,
           c2.category_name AS category_2,
           poc2.product_orders AS product_orders_2,
           pc.pair_orders
    FROM pair_counts pc
    JOIN public.products p1 ON p1.product_id = pc.product_id_1
    JOIN public.products p2 ON p2.product_id = pc.product_id_2
    JOIN public.categories c1 ON c1.category_id = p1.category_id
    JOIN public.categories c2 ON c2.category_id = p2.category_id
    JOIN product_order_counts poc1 ON poc1.product_id = pc.product_id_1
    JOIN product_order_counts poc2 ON poc2.product_id = pc.product_id_2
    WHERE p1.category_id <> p2.category_id
)
SELECT pwm.product_id_1,
       pwm.product_name_1,
       pwm.category_1,
       pwm.product_id_2,
       pwm.product_name_2,
       pwm.category_2,
       pwm.pair_orders,
       (pwm.pair_orders / NULLIF((pwm.product_orders_1 * pwm.product_orders_2) / to2.n_orders, 0)) AS lift
FROM pair_with_meta pwm
CROSS JOIN total_orders to2
WHERE pwm.pair_orders >= 3
ORDER BY lift DESC NULLS LAST, pwm.pair_orders DESC, pwm.product_id_1, pwm.product_id_2

per_query.question: In welchen Monaten stieg die Frachtkostenquote gegenueber dem Vormonat am staerksten?
per_query.reference_sql:
WITH order_revenue AS (
    SELECT o.order_id,
           DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date AS month,
           o.freight,
           SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS revenue
    FROM public.orders o
    JOIN public.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY o.order_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date, o.freight
),
month_agg AS (
    SELECT month,
           SUM(freight) AS total_freight,
           SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue,
           (SUM(freight) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0)) AS freight_ratio
    FROM order_revenue
    GROUP BY month
),
with_prev AS (
    SELECT month,
           total_freight,
           total_revenue,
           freight_ratio,
           LAG(freight_ratio) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_ratio
    FROM month_agg
)
SELECT month,
       total_freight,
       total_revenue,
       freight_ratio,
       (freight_ratio - prev_ratio) AS ratio_increase_vs_prev_month
FROM with_prev
WHERE prev_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ratio_increase_vs_prev_month DESC, month

per_query.question: Welche Lieferanten haben viele Produkte, aber einen niedrigen Anteil verkaufter Produkte?

SELECT s.company_name, COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count, 
       SUM(od.quantity) AS total_sold, 
       CASE WHEN COUNT(p.product_id) > 0 THEN SUM(od.quantity) * 1.0 / COUNT(p.product_id) ELSE 0 END AS sold_ratio
FROM public.suppliers s
JOIN public.products p ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id
LEFT JOIN public.order_details od ON p.product_id = od.product_id
GROUP BY s.company_name
HAVING COUNT(p.product_id) > 5 AND (SUM(od.quantity) * 1.0 / COUNT(p.product_id)) < 1
ORDER BY sold_ratio ASC, product_count DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH supplier_product_coverage AS (
    SELECT s.supplier_id,
           s.company_name,
           COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) AS total_products,
           COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) FILTER (WHERE od.order_id IS NOT NULL) AS sold_products
    FROM public.suppliers s
    JOIN public.products p ON p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
    LEFT JOIN public.order_details od ON od.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.company_name
)
SELECT supplier_id,
       company_name,
       total_products,
       sold_products,
       (sold_products::numeric / NULLIF(total_products, 0)) AS sold_share
FROM supplier_product_coverage
ORDER BY sold_share ASC NULLS FIRST, total_products DESC, supplier_id
